title: dsc dump-schemas --json
description: What `dsc dump-schemas --json` writes ([RCLI.1.14]): the schemas the input declares, each slot's declared type, and for a unit-typed slot its unit and the conversion to its dimension's base unit. The residue this schema cannot carry is [RCLI.1.14]'s.

schemas.description: The schemas the input declares, in declaration order.

slots.description: The schema's slots, in declaration order.

type.description: The slot's declared type as the source names it, without the `?` of a nullable slot.

unit.description: The slot's unit, or null for a slot that is not unit-typed.

declared.description: The canonical symbol of the unit the slot names, or null for a slot typed by its dimension or scalar group.

label.description: The declared unit's label, or null when it declares none or the slot names no unit.

base.description: The canonical symbol of the dimension's base unit.

conversion.description: From the declared unit to the base unit, or null when the slot names no unit.

affine.description: base = a * declared + b, with the constants the compiler bakes.

tier2.description: A tier-2 unit, whose conversion is not affine.
